# Synthetic ODB fill smoke input

These neutral LEF/DEF/rules inputs test the OpenROAD command and ODB handoff.
They are not GF180 or any other process's rules and are not a qualification
reference. There is one routed signal, no standard-cell library, and one metal
layer. Native insertion/readback and unchanged non-fill geometry are measured;
no foundry density/DRC/RCX/tapeout acceptance is asserted.
